info.title: UNSW-NB15
info.subtitle: Network Intrusion Detection, ISG group @UNSW Canberra
info.description:
This is an academic intrusion detection dataset. All the credit goes to the original authors: dr. Nour Moustafa and dr. Jill Slay. 

Please cite their [original paper](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/7348942) and all other appropriate articles listed on the [UNSW-NB15](https://research.unsw.edu.au/projects/unsw-nb15-dataset) page. 

The full dataset also offers the pcap, BRO and Argus files along with additional documentation.

V1: Original CSVs obtained from [here](https://research.unsw.edu.au/projects/unsw-nb15-dataset)
V2: [Cleaning -> parquet](https://www.kaggle.com/dhoogla/unsw-nb15-00-cleaning)
V3: Reorganize to save storage, only keep original CSVs in V1/V2
V4: Update to remove contaminating features [[presentation](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/363265363_Discovering_Non-Metadata_Contaminant_Features_in_Intrusion_Detection_Datasets)] & [[conference article](http://dx.doi.org/10.1109/PST55820.2022.9851974)]

My modifications to the predesignated train-test sets are minimal and designed to decrease disk storage and increase performance & reliability.

In its current iteration, the dataset can be loaded trivially with `pd.read_parquet()`. All data types are already set correctly and there are 0 records with missing information.
Reading parquet files does require [fastparquet](https://pypi.org/project/fastparquet/) and / or [pyarrow](https://pypi.org/project/pyarrow/)

Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) through [classification with very simple models to .877 AUROC](https://www.kaggle.com/code/dhoogla/unsw-nb15-01-eda-oner-0-877-roc-auc).
info.userSpecifiedSources: The base version from the dataset is sourced from https://research.unsw.edu.au/projects/unsw-nb15-dataset.
